mapper.sql: (c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_share cs JOIN workspace vws ON vws.id = cs.workspace_id JOIN workspace ows ON ows.id = c.workspace_id AND ows.org_id = vws.org_id WHERE cs.company_id = c.id AND cs.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})) AND c.archived_at IS NULL

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_edge e JOIN person peer ON peer.id = IF(e.source_person_id = p.id, e.target_person_id, e.source_person_id) AND peer.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND peer.intro_excluded = FALSE AND peer.suspended_at IS NULL AND peer.archived_at IS NULL WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.source_person_id = p.id OR e.target_person_id = p.id) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO introduction (workspace_id, introducer_user_id, person_a_id, person_b_id, status, note, introduced_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{introducerUserId}, #{personAId}, #{personBId}, 'made', #{note}, #{introducedAt}) AS ni ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'made', introducer_user_id = ni.introducer_user_id, note = ni.note, introduced_at = ni.introduced_at

INSERT INTO introduction (workspace_id, introducer_user_id, person_a_id, person_b_id, status, introduced_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{introducerUserId}, #{personAId}, #{personBId}, 'dismissed', #{introducedAt}) AS ni ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(introduction.status = 'made', introduction.status, 'dismissed')
mapper.sql: SELECT i.id AS id, i.person_a_id AS person_a_id, pa.name AS person_a_name, ca.name AS person_a_company, pa.image_url AS person_a_image_url, i.person_b_id AS person_b_id, pb.name AS person_b_name, cb.name AS person_b_company, pb.image_url AS person_b_image_url, i.introducer_user_id AS introducer_id, i.note AS note, i.introduced_at AS introduced_at FROM introduction i JOIN person pa ON pa.id = i.person_a_id AND pa.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND pa.archived_at IS NULL JOIN person pb ON pb.id = i.person_b_id AND pb.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND pb.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company ca ON ca.id = pa.company_id AND ca.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND ca.archived_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN company cb ON cb.id = pb.company_id AND cb.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND cb.archived_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM introduction WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'made'

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.title AS title, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, p.image_url AS image_url FROM person p LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = p.company_id AND WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.intro_excluded = FALSE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id = p.id) OR )

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.title AS title, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, p.image_url AS image_url FROM person p LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = p.company_id AND WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.intro_excluded = FALSE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id = p.id) OR ) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT person_id AS person_id, company_id AS company_id, company_name AS company_name, started_at AS started_at, ended_at AS ended_at FROM person_employment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY person_id, id
SELECT person_a_id AS person_a_id, person_b_id AS person_b_id FROM introduction WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM introduction WHERE introducer_user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.title AS title, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, p.image_url AS image_url FROM person p LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = p.company_id AND WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.intro_excluded = FALSE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.archived_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND intro_excluded = TRUE AND suspended_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.intro_excluded = TRUE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id = p.id) OR )
SELECT id FROM person WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND intro_excluded = TRUE AND suspended_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT target_person_id AS target_person_id, bridge_person_id AS bridge_person_id FROM warm_path_dismissal WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warm_path_dismissal (workspace_id, target_person_id, bridge_person_id, status, dismissed_by_user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{targetPersonId}, #{bridgePersonId}, #{status}, #{userId}) AS nd ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(warm_path_dismissal.status = 'accepted', warm_path_dismissal.status, nd.status), dismissed_by_user_id = IF(warm_path_dismissal.status = 'accepted', warm_path_dismissal.dismissed_by_user_id, nd.dismissed_by_user_id)
INSERT INTO warm_path_dismissal (workspace_id, target_person_id, bridge_person_id, status, dismissed_by_user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{targetPersonId}, NULL, #{status}, #{userId})
